title: Source code that handles credentials safely: must not be flagged
summary: JavaScript, Python and Terraform snippets that read credentials from the environment. Covers 20 inputs.
rationale: Code that mentions credentials is far more common than code that contains one.
unscopedReason: Authored detector and arrival-target metadata intentionally assign no credential family; this fixture remains a global benchmark control.
